base_url.description: Your Gorgias account API root, e.g. https://<domain>.gorgias.com/api. Supply the /api root because connector paths are API-root relative.

username.description: Gorgias account email used for HTTP Basic auth.

password.description: Gorgias API key used as the HTTP Basic auth password; never logged.

page_size.description: Records per page for cursor-paginated list streams (1-100).

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free conformance.

custom_field_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `custom_field` stream (/custom-fields/{id}).

customer_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `customer_id` for the `customer_custom_fields_values` stream (/customers/{customer_id}/custom-fields).

event_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `event` stream (/events/{id}).

integration_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `integration` stream (/integrations/{id}).

job_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `job` stream (/jobs/{id}).

macro_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `macro` stream (/macros/{id}).

slug.description: Gorgias path parameter `slug` for the `metric_card` stream (/metric-cards/{slug}).

voice_call_event_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `voice_call_event` stream (/phone/voice-call-events/{id}).

voice_call_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `voice_call` stream (/phone/voice-calls/{id}).

rule_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `rule` stream (/rules/{id}).

satisfaction_survey_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `satisfaction_survey` stream (/satisfaction-surveys/{id}).

tag_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `tag` stream (/tags/{id}).

team_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `team` stream (/teams/{id}).

ticket_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `ticket` stream (/tickets/{id}).

ticket_message_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `ticket_message` stream (/tickets/{ticket_id}/messages/{id}).

user_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `user` stream (/users/{id}).

view_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `view` stream (/views/{id}).

widget_id.description: Gorgias path parameter `id` for the `widget` stream (/widgets/{id}).
